question: Show the three cheapest products
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 3

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Number of orders per region
sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.name

question: What is the highest order total?
sql: SELECT MAX(total) AS max_total FROM orders

question: Which customers placed the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total quantity of items per product
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name

question: Average order total per region
sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(o.total) AS avg_total FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.name

question: Which product has the lowest price?
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1
